# Tags with an Ante Bellum mission tree. They are highlighted in the Ante Bellum map mode, and the
# country panel shows their tree.
#
# One tag per line. The script finds the tag's tree in the AB_*.txt mission files by itself, using
# the 1444 tag, culture, religion, government reforms and so on.
# To choose the files yourself, write them after "=", e.g.:   ZUN = AB_Persia_PER.txt
# "found:" comments show what the script detected when this file was generated. Lines starting with
# # are ignored.
